name: 4x4 X-treme Off-Roader
instructions: omr/instructions/42099-1-1.pdf (one book, 224 pages: front axle with both front motors steps 1-126, rear axle and its motor steps 127-202, frame and hub steps 203-238, body steps 239-335, wheels steps 336-337; the app's controls are drawn on pages 218-219)

functions.does: The front XL motor drives the front wheels: the 20 tooth gear on its shaft drives a 12 tooth gear on a long shaft running forward to another 20 tooth gear, which drives a 12 tooth gear whose shaft carries the 20 tooth gear that turns the front differential; constant velocity joints take the drive out to the planetary reduction hubs.
functions.source: book: front motor steps 72-86 (marked 4), front axle steps 1-37 and 87, hubs steps 39-53; app pages 218-219; the gear train is inferred from the model
functions.note: The motor (p621 42099 - 22172, a Control+ XL motor) turns the control, the 20 tooth gear on its shaft. Driven from the Control+ app through the hub (p1199 42099 - 22127).

functions.does: The rear XL motor drives the rear wheels the same way: the 20 tooth gear on its shaft drives a 12 tooth gear on a shaft running back to another 20 tooth gear, which drives a 12 tooth gear whose shaft carries the 20 tooth gear that turns the rear differential, then constant velocity joints and the planetary reduction hubs.
functions.source: book: rear axle steps 127-172, rear motor steps 173-180 (marked 2); app pages 218-219; the gear train is inferred from the model
functions.note: The motor (p134 42099 - 22172, a Control+ XL motor) turns the control, the 20 tooth gear on its shaft.

functions.does: With both XL motors driven together the off-roader has four-wheel drive, forwards or back.
functions.note: The app drives both XL motors at once from one control.

functions.does: The L motor steers the front wheels: a 12 tooth gear on its shaft drives a toothed rack across the front axle, which pushes the steering links on ball joints to swing both front hubs; a tie rod behind the axle joins the two hubs.
functions.source: book: steering motor steps 88-106 (marked 3), steering parts steps 54-71 and 107-126; app pages 218-219 (steering control); the gear and rack are inferred from the model
functions.note: The motor (p883 42099 - 22169, a Control+ L motor) turns the control, the 12 tooth gear on its shaft.

functions.does: The front axle has an open differential: with the front motor still, turning one front wheel turns the other the opposite way.
functions.source: book: front axle steps 8-37 (the differential in its housing)

functions.does: The rear axle has an open differential too: with the rear motor still, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.

The front half of the chassis (front axle, both front motors) twists against the rear half (rear axle, its motor, the hub and the body) about a lengthwise axis, on two large turntables, one at the very front and one in the middle, so all four wheels stay on rough ground.
functions.source: book: front turntable steps 102-105 (with an inset showing how it is lined up), middle turntable steps 198-202; inferred: that this is the articulation, from where the turntables sit
functions.note: Unsure: whether either axle also swings on its own against its half of the chassis.

functions.does: Four red shock absorbers, two on each axle, spring the axles against the chassis.
functions.source: book: front axle step 87, rear axle steps 164-171, body fitted steps 333-335

functions.does: The small steering wheel on the dashboard turns freely; it isn't joined to the steering.
functions.source: inferred: book body step 302 fits it on a short axle in the dashboard, with nothing behind it
